cards.text:
V-TD10/001EN
Interdimensional Beast, Metallica Phoenix
Normal Unit｜ Gear Chronicle｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield -
[CONT]:You cannot normal ride this card.

V-TD10/002EN
Chronojet Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Gear Chronicle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[ACT](VC):[COST][Discard one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand], search your deck for up to one grade 4 card, ride it as [Stand], and shuffle your deck. At the end of the turn, retire that unit, and ride a grade 3 card from your soul as [Rest].
[AUTO](VC/RC):When it attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and until end of that battle, this unit gets [Power] +5000, and your opponent cannot call sentinels from his or her hand.

V-TD10/003EN
Steam Gunner, Yarlaganda
Normal Unit｜ Gear Chronicle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC/RC):When it attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], draw a card, and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-TD10/004EN
Stroboscope Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Gear Chronicle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):At the end of the battle it attacked, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & discard a card from your hand], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, retire it, and if your vanguard is grade 4, draw a card.

Normal Unit｜ Gear Chronicle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000

[AUTO](VC):When placed, draw a card, and discard a card from your hand.
